description: Triangular photo collage of breakfast plates (french toast, berry tart, egg & toast, salad+bacon) — top-left of board 1, directly above the 'Breakfast Plates' heading.
Triangular photo collage of french toast dishes (bacon plate, egg toast, borek, croissant/berries) — top area of board 1, above the 'French Toast' heading, right of the breakfast-plates collage.
Round strawberry-nutella waffle plate photo with fork and napkin — above the 'Strawberry Nutella Waffle' column.
Round waffle plate photo topped with banana/kiwi/strawberry/pistachio, fork and napkin — above the 'Waffle Street Special' column.
Pancake stack photo with strawberry, banana and chocolate drizzle — above the 'Classic Pancake' column, right side of board 1.

Circular Greek salad bowl photo on the green 'Salads' panel, bottom-right of board 1. NOTE: includes the dark-green circular 'Fresh' badge overlapping its top-left corner (badge text is baked into this photo — recreate the badge separately in CSS and layer it on top, or crop it off).
Sample patch of the dark wood-plank texture background behind the 'Appetizers & Sides' panel, bottom-left of board 1 (real photographic wood grain, not a flat color).
Sample patch of the dark-green illustrated food-icon pattern (tomato/veg outlines) used as background texture on the 'Salads' panel, bottom-right of board 1.
Triangular photo collage of cakes/pastries (berry cake, opera cake, tiramisu, carrot cake, cheesecake, tres leches slice) — top-left of board 2, above 'Mumu's Homemade Pastries' heading.

Overhead photo of banana, blueberries, strawberries and pudding/parfait cups on marble — bottom-left of board 2, near the 'Cups' heading. The 'Parfait Cup / Fresh Fruit Cup' price text that originally overlapped the top-right corner of this photo region was painted over with the matching background color to keep this crop text-free.

Diamond-shaped photo pair (everything-bagel breakfast sandwich, top-left triangle; ham & egg croissant sandwich, bottom-right triangle) beside the 'Croissant & Bagel' heading, board 2. Background auto-masked to white to remove the overlapping 'Croissant & Bagel' script text.
Triangular photo of sliced wrap halves (pinwheel arrangement) beside the 'Wrap' heading, board 2. Background auto-masked to white to remove surrounding text.

Triangular photo of a stacked caprese panini sandwich beside the 'Panini' heading, board 2. Background auto-masked to white to remove surrounding text; right/bottom edges trimmed slightly to drop a stray sliver of the neighboring sandwich photo.
